title: Use Selective Honesty and Generosity to Disarm Your Victim
hook: A disclosed crack in the walnut cabinet lowers the buyer's guard more than a polished pitch.
counterintuition: The obvious move is to trust the label. The stronger move is to read the pressure underneath it and act before selective honesty turns costly.
tryThisNow: Look at one live situation today and name the visible sign of selective honesty. Change one sentence, object, or sequence so the safer reading appears first.
keyTakeaway: Use a precise act of candor or generosity to lower suspicion without surrendering the whole position.
